Shot size: DETAIL. Tight detail of a finger tapping an exception note on the tablet while a small sensor trace preview appears.
Focal point: finger tapping exception note and sensor trace preview.

[CURRENT ACTION / CONTENT]
Isolate the narrated object or action: but the crew still verifies them—reading the brief exception note, opening a recent sensor trace if something looks off, and deciding whether a local intervention is warranted.

[CHARACTERS PRESENT]
on‑shift crew member / protagonist: present, canonical identity established via the supplied reference image.
wall tablet checklist UI (icons: O2/H2O/power): present (described, no dedicated reference image for this shot).

[LOCATION]
habitat living module (with porthole and tablet UI) — camera anchor: hab_tablet_cam

[WORLD STATE]
- timeOfDay: day
- lightingSpectra: blue_enriched

[FACTUAL CONSTRAINTS]
- Habit lighting and shown sol length should reflect Mars sol concept and tunable circadian lighting cues.

REFERENCE BOARD: The supplied image contains canonical reference material for this scene, arranged as a grid. It is source material ONLY.
Do NOT reproduce the board/collage/grid layout. Output ONE finished cinematic 16:9 scene.
Preserve, from each reference panel in the board:
- Panel 1 (e_protagonist): character identity/outfit, exactly as shown.
- Panel 2 (l_habitat_module): location geometry/design, exactly as shown.
Integrate all of the above naturally into the requested scene composition.
